dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress web site as a raster image.
Color coding indicates the location of Union and Confederate forces.
In the Robert Knox Sneden Scrapbook (Mss5:7 Sn237:1 p. 115).
NOTE: Researchers will be served a color photocopy of this scrapbook image.
Robert Knox Sneden Diary (Mss5:1 Sn237:1), Virginia Historical Society, Richmond, Va.
Shows fortifications on opposite sides of the Warwick River, with the Confederate forces concentrated to the north of the river and the Union forces to the south around Lee's Mill.
This item is from the collections of the Virginia Historical Society; please contact the institution for more information.
dct_title_s: The Union assault on the Rebel works at Lee's Mill, Yorktown, Va.
